enrichment.headline: Accepts a free after-school bike club from Cycles of Change at Oakland International High School
enrichment.summary: Ratifies a no-cost agreement with Cycles of Change to run a bike club after school at Oakland International High School for newcomer students. The club offers hands-on cycling, fitness and safe-biking skills, and a chance to practice English with peers. It runs November 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026 at no cost to the district.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: No Cost Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Cycles of Change - Oakland International High School

enrichment.headline: Accepts free music program from Living Jazz at La Escuelita Elementary School
enrichment.summary: Ratifies a no-cost agreement with Living Jazz to teach music at La Escuelita Elementary School, aiming to build creativity, confidence, self-expression and teamwork. It runs December 1, 2025 through May 28, 2026 at no cost to the district.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: No Cost Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Living Jazz - La Escuelita Elementary School

enrichment.headline: Pays F3 and Associates up to $148,995 for land surveys at six school sites
enrichment.summary: Approves an agreement with F3 and Associates, Inc. for land surveys, including ground surveys and underground utility location, at six schools in connection with soil sampling and environmental assessment projects. The limit of $148,995 includes $13,545 held for additional services if the district directs them. Work is scheduled from January 29 to March 30, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: Approves a master agreement with The KDI Group, Inc. to provide DSA-certified inspector of record services at school construction projects. DSA is the Division of the State Architect, which oversees school building safety. The agreement is for $0 now, and future project assignments will come back to the Board separately. It starts January 29, 2026 and ends when all assigned projects are done.

enrichment.headline: Cuts $630,987 from Syserco's CAL Shape design-build contract, now $11.09M, and shortens it 27 days
enrichment.summary: Approves a change order that lowers the price of the Syserco Energy Solutions contract by $630,986.67, from $11,720,359.50 to $11,089,372.83, as credit for deleted plumbing work. It also cuts the contract time by 27 days. The work covers four school sites, and the change order combines preliminary change orders (PCOs) 1 through 8.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Extends Asbestos Management Group's demolition contract to June 30, 2026 at no added cost
enrichment.summary: Approves a change order that extends the contract term from December 31, 2025 to June 30, 2026, an added 181 days, for the Ralph Bunche and Hillside site demolition projects. The work was paused so another contractor could finish urgent hazardous waste cleanup after a fire. No added money is stated.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Change Order No. 2, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor - Asbestos Management Group - Ralph Bunche and Hillside School Sites Demolition Projects - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Buys turf replacement at Calvin Simmons Middle School from Shaw Sports for up to $463,244
enrichment.summary: Approves buying and installing new synthetic turf at Calvin Simmons Middle School from Shaw Sports Synthetic Turf, up to $463,244, including $42,113 for contingencies. The district is buying through a California Multiple Award Schedules (CMAS) contract, a state-approved purchasing list, instead of running its own bid. Work runs January 29, 2026 to January 29, 2027.

vendor.name: Shaw Integrated and Turf Solutions Inc., dba Shaw Sports Synthetic Turf

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
